drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.body: Unsaved changes stay in this tab until reload or sign-out, and are offered again when the editor reopens.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: Dates, times, and a place can be set now or later. The itinerary shows the place beside its time.

reminder.title: Reminders
reminder.body: A reminder is recorded on the event; no notification is sent.

noteText.title: Text
noteText.body: Plain text. Line breaks are kept and links open when the note is read.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: The Name field lists your own account and your friends as you type; picking one links the card to that account and fills in its contacts. A linked card reaches that account for shares and invitations; clear the mark in the field to unlink and keep the name.

fields.title: Fields
fields.body: Anything worth keeping about a person: a birthday, a dietary note.

pages.title: Pages
pages.body: Pages organize this event. Start blank or choose a few useful views.

presets.title: Presets
presets.body: A preset adds one page of event-wide views. Existing pages and records stay unchanged.

tabs.title: Reordering
tabs.body: Drag a row, or press its grip and use the arrow keys, to reorder. The eye hides a tab but keeps it here; the cross takes a view off the event (its records stay; the gallery brings it back).

fixedTabs.title: Fixed tabs
fixedTabs.body: Overview, Tasks, Sharing and Removed links can be hidden but not removed.
